en: Wait, Nico!! Let's go together, okay?

jp: マティアを捜す間だけだからね
en: Only until we find Matia, got it?
Yeah.
It's dark in here.

jp: ふだんはもっと明るいのに
en: That's strange. It's usually much brighter.
Don't you smell something weird?

jp: いつもはこんな匂いしないのに
en: You're right... It never smells like this.

jp: 本当にこんなところに
en: ...Matia. Did she really come to a place like this?
GRAAAAAAAAH!!
Waaah!!

jp: メフィストさんの声だ！！
en: That's Mephisto-san's voice!!

jp: すごく嫌な感じがする
en: What is this... I've got a really bad feeling.
...What's this, now?
Eek!!

jp: ここで、何をしているんだ！？
en: What are you doing here!?

jp: マティアはどこにいるんだ！？
en: Matia? Where's Matia!?

jp: この嬢ちゃんのことか？
en: ...Matia? You mean this little lady?
Matia!!

jp: マティアに何をしたんだ！！
en: What did you do to Matia!!

jp: 悪いけど嬢ちゃんに用があってな
ちょーっとおねんねして
en: Sorry, but I had business with the little lady. Just put her down for a nap, that's all.

jp: やっぱりそうだ・・・
この人、すごく嫌な感じがする
en: I knew it... This man gives me a really bad feeling.
Don't you touch Matia!!

jp: この俺にケンカを売るとは
en: ...Oh? Picking a fight with me? You've got some nerve, haven't you?
W-waaah!! A-a-a demon!!!
Nico!?

jp: いいお友達を持ったもんだな
en: HYAA-HAHAHA! Some friend you've got there.

jp: さあて、お前はどうする？
お姫様はここにいるんだぜ？
逃げ出すか、それとも・・・
en: Now then, what'll you do? Your princess is right here. Run for it, or...

jp: 肉もやわらかそうだし
en: Heh, now that I look, that flesh looks tender. Pale skin, just how I like it.

jp: 切り刻んだら血の色が
en: Oh, yes... Carve you up and the color of blood would really show.

jp: 遊んでやってもいいんだぜ？
en: I wouldn't mind playing with you a little, you know?

jp: でも、ここで逃げ出したら
en: This man... he's terrifying!! But if I run now, Matia will...!!

jp: やっぱりお前も逃げ出すのか？
en: Kukuku, what'll it be? You going to run too, after all?
I won't hand Matia over to the likes of you!!!

jp: ヒャーハッハッハッハッ！！！
en: HYAA-HAHAHAHA!!! Oh, I like that look in your eyes!

jp: そういう反抗的な目が
en: Defiant eyes like those are what get me going most.

jp: 是非ともその目を涙でぬらして
俺の前にひざまずき、命乞いを
してもらいたいもんだな！
en: I'd love to see those eyes wet with tears as you kneel before me and beg for your life!

jp: 俺が丁寧に首をはねてやるよ
en: And once you're done begging, I'll take your head off nice and neat.
That would be a problem.
Huh?
Johannes!!

jp: 悪魔がいったい何の用だ？
en: What business does a demon have on another's land?

jp: 人がこれからお楽しみって時に
en: ...Tch! Just when a man was about to have his fun, and you go and spoil it.

jp: てめぇに用はねぇんだよ
死にたくなかったら失せな
en: I've got no business with you. Beat it, if you don't want to die.

jp: 消えるのはお前の方だ
en: You are the one who will be leaving.

jp: 大人しく立ち去るのなら
en: Leave quietly, and I will let you go.

jp: 誰に向かって意見してるんだよ
en: Huh? Who do you think you're talking to?

jp: 警告は一度しか言わない
大人しくここを出ていかぬのなら
力ずくでも出ていってもらおう！
en: I will only warn you once. If you will not leave quietly, I will remove you by force!

jp: やれるもんならやってみな！！
en: ...Keh! Try it, if you think you can!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
